args.code: (() => { var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#select-container .select-card button'); for (var i=0; i<buttons.length; i++) { var card = buttons[i].closest('.select-card'); if (card && card.textContent.includes('耕读传家')) { buttons[i].click(); return 'clicked 耕读传家 at index ' + i; } } if (buttons.length > 1) { buttons[1].click(); return 'clicked button index 1'; } if (typeof selectMode === 'function') { selectMode('normal'); return 'selectMode(normal) called'; } return 'no button found, buttons=' + buttons.length; })()
